content:
anya (prod-routes): Heads-up — we need a concrete proposal for automatic model-variant fallback when a tenant's primary model is saturated. Thinking: capacity-based handoff that respects tiering and latency SLOs.
kevin (eng-platform): +1. We should define: (1) policy shape in the route config, (2) observable signals (fallback_rate, fallback_latency_penalty), (3) API/response surface so customers know when fallback happened.
luca (eng-runtime): Runtime-wise we can switch at request admission if queue + active tokens exceed capacity threshold. Problem: streaming + function-calls need consistent variant for whole request. We can gate fallback at request start.
sam (sre): How about a circuit-breaker that trips per-tenant-model and then routes to next variant for X seconds? That avoids flapping. Also need alerting on sustained fallback_rate.
maria (product): Customers will want control. Two UX options: opt-in silent fallback (platform auto-swaps) or explicit config where they pick fallback priority. Also expose a console toggle.
anya (prod-routes): Proposal sketch: route config fields: `allow_capacity_fallback` (bool), `fallback_preference` (ordered list), `fallback_cooldown_s`. Example:
```json
{
  "route": "acme/production",
  "allow_capacity_fallback": true,
  "fallback_preference": ["rwd-4o-q8", "rwd-4o-q4"],
  "fallback_cooldown_s": 60
}
```
kevin (eng-platform): Love that. Also add `fallback_scope`: `tenant|global` — tenant-scoped prevents noisy neighbors. Default should be tenant.
luca (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: we need to measure effective capacity consumption not just GPU queue length (tokens-in-flight + model-specific throughput). We'll add signal `model_pressure_score` computed in runtime.
sam (sre): Telemetry: emit `fallback.decisions` with tags: tenant_id, primary_model, chosen_variant, reason=capacity. Dashboard: "Fallbacks by tier" and alert if >5% sustained for 5m for enterprise customers.
maria (product): API surface: return header `x-rwd-fallback: <variant-id>` and a field in the JSON response `meta.fallback_used`. Customers can opt-out of the header if they want silent behavior for UX.
kevin (eng-platform): Backwards compatibility: for old routes with no config, default to disabled. New route creation UI should have a small explainer and a recommended default for each tier (e.g., self-serve: off, growth: on, enterprise: on).
anya (prod-routes): Rollout plan: feature flag `tiered_capacity_fallback_v1`. Start with internal tenants, then opt-in beta customers, then gradual on for enterprise. Canary: 1% traffic across mixed tiers.
luca (eng-runtime): Edge cases: model-variant family mismatch (e.g., primary uses extended context). We should only fallback to variants that accept the same max_seq or gracefully degrade with a warning in `meta`. Also enforce compatibility matrix at route creation.
sam (sre): Cost/tokens: when fallback happens to cheaper quantized variants, billing still ties to the route's model pricing policy. Need product decision. For transparency, emit `fallback_cost_delta` in telemetry.
maria (product): Decision: keep billing tied to effective variant (more fair). We'll draft pricing doc but expose estimated per-call cost in console before toggle.
kevin (eng-platform): Console work: add a per-route "Fallbacks" card showing rate, latency delta, top chosen variants, and a small "simulate" button to run a short synthetic test to validate behavior.
anya (prod-routes): Security & audit: log every fallback decision in audit logs with request id for troubleshooting. Also add an allowlist for variants allowed for private tenants.
luca (eng-runtime): Implementation timeline: 2 sprint infra work to compute `model_pressure_score` + decision service, 1 sprint to wire into admission path, 1 sprint for telemetry + dashboard.
kevin (eng-platform): API debate: should we add a new query param `prefer_primary=true|false` to force no-fallback per-request? That gives customers control for critical calls. Thoughts?
maria (product): +1 on `prefer_primary` but default should be false. Document that forcing primary may cause 429s when primary saturated.
sam (sre): Tests: add chaos test that injects GPU saturation and assert fallback_rate increases and no large latency regressions for prioritized tiers.
anya (prod-routes): Okay actionable items: @kevin create route config PR with schema, @luca prototype decision service, @sam add SLO/alert recipes, @maria write product/console copy and pricing note. I'll coordinate opt-in pilot.
kevin (eng-platform): I'll open the PR today. quick q: should we surface fallback events in the `requests` index in console trace view? I vote yes.
maria (product): Yes — traces should show `fallback:variant_id` in step list.
infra-bot: deploy queued — canary: none (manual step).
kevin (eng-platform): Thanks all. I'll link the PR here when ready. :thumbsup:
anya (prod-routes): Closing loop: we'll reconvene after the pilot metrics (fallback_rate, cost_delta, latency_95) are in. :eyes:
